program.name: WIC family-category route
program.description: Routes pregnant/recently pregnant people and households with a child under five to local WIC screening.

actions.label: Apply for WIC or find a local office

versions.source_label: California WIC public eligibility and local application route
versions.notice: Routing pre-screen only. WIC staff review categorical, residency, nutrition-risk, and income requirements.

conditions.pass_reason: The entered ZIP appears to be in San Diego County.
conditions.fail_reason: This pilot only shows San Diego routes.
conditions.unknown_reason: A ZIP is needed for local WIC routing.
conditions.expected_text: A ZIP routed to San Diego County

conditions.pass_reason: Pregnancy or recent pregnancy may fit a WIC participant category.
conditions.unknown_reason: Pregnancy/recent-pregnancy status could open a WIC route.

conditions.pass_reason: A child under five may fit a WIC participant category.
conditions.fail_reason: A child under five was not reported.
conditions.unknown_reason: Whether there is a child under five could open a WIC route.

next_steps.MAY_QUALIFY: Contact a local WIC office for the official appointment and income/nutrition review.
next_steps.NEEDS_INFORMATION: Answer the family-category question or contact WIC directly.
next_steps.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Use direct food and CalFresh routes; WIC staff can explain less common categories.
next_steps.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: Use the current California WIC route.

result_summaries.DIRECT_RESOURCE: Available to everyone without completing the eligibility survey.
result_summaries.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Your current answers meet every rule included in this pre-screen. The official agency still decides.
result_summaries.MAY_QUALIFY: Your current answers make this a useful next step, but the provider or agency must confirm remaining requirements.
result_summaries.NEEDS_INFORMATION: A small number of unanswered items could change this result.
result_summaries.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: At least one current answer does not meet this pre-screen. Open the details to compare what was expected with what you entered.
result_summaries.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: SANDI will not rely on this rule until its owner reviews the current version.
